title: A.R.M.O.R. solar battery stack reading
description: The readings of one battery stack (Pylontech console table, summarised as a stack). With no module present the message has modules 0 and no other reading. Published to armor/solar/{node_id}/{device}/state.

current_a.description: Sum of the modules: positive while charging.

soc_percent.description: Mean state of charge; left out when unknown.

alarm.description: True when any module reports a state that is not normal.

cells_v.description: The voltage of every cell of the module, in volts, in cell order; left out when the node does not read them.

counters.description: The counters of the life of the module that its console prints (the names in the console's own words, lowercase with underscores: bat_ov_times, coc_times, ...). What a counter means is not official. An increase of a protection counter is worth telling; left out when the node does not read them.

temperatures_c.description: The temperature sensors of the module; left out when the node does not read them.

health_percent.description: The capacity the module has learned against its rated one, in percent; left out when unknown.

model.description: The module's own model as its console says it (US2000, US3000C...). A stack may mix models, and the rules of a group (which model may be the master, how many modules each model allows) depend on them; left out when the node does not read it.

cell_count.description: How many cells the module has, from its console's info.

max_charge_a.description: The charge current the module says it allows, in amperes (positive), from its console's info.

max_discharge_a.description: The discharge current the module says it allows, in amperes (positive), from its console's info.

console_baud.description: The speed the module says its console uses (an old unit says 19200).

soh_counts.description: The state-of-health count of each cell, in cell order, from the console's soh; left out when the node does not read it.

soh_abnormal.description: The cells (0-based, like cells_v) whose state of health the console does not call Normal; present with soh_counts.

index.description: The item index in the battery's event log.

time.description: The time of the entry as the battery prints it (its own clock, not the node's).

power_events.description: The pack's protection events exactly as the console prints them: the hexadecimal number and the mnemonic beside it (0x2 PHV). Never decoded by the node.

battery_events.description: The cells' protection events as printed (0x4 BVNOR).

last_event.description: The newest entry of the module's event log (the console's data event), shown as the console prints it; left out when the node does not read it.

board_version.description: The module's board version from its console's info (V10R04).

main_soft_version.description: The module's main software version from info (B68.2.0.0).

soft_version.description: The module's software version from info (V2.6).

model.description: The battery's model as it reports it (US3000C...).

capacity_ah.description: Remaining capacity of the stack in ampere-hours (the modules' add up).

full_capacity_ah.description: Full (total) capacity of the stack in ampere-hours.

energy_kwh.description: Energy left in the stack in kilowatt-hours: the remaining capacity times the voltage.

cycles.description: Charge cycles of the most used module.

health_percent.description: Mean of the modules' health (the capacity learned against the rated one); left out when no module knows it.

power_w.description: What a battery management system measures for the stack, in watts: negative while discharging. Left out when the equipment does not say.

balancing.description: How many cells are being balanced at this moment; left out when unknown.

protecting.description: True when a protection of the battery management system has switched a MOSFET off (not merely off, full or waiting).

charge_mos.description: The status code of the charge MOSFET as the battery management system reports it (0 off, 1 on, the rest a protection or a state).

discharge_mos.description: The status code of the discharge MOSFET, as above.
